item.title: CV
item.description: I’m currently pursuing my PhD in Philosophy at the Ruhr-University Bochum, supervized by Albert Newen, Christian Straßer and Leonard Dung. My dissertation will be on the topic: “Deception by Large Language Models: A Mechanistic Perspective Grounded in the Philosophy of Artificial Minds”. I graduated in Data Science (M.Sc.) at Fernuniversität Hagen, 2026. Philosophy (M.A.) at Ruhr-Universität Bochum, 2024. Mathematics and Philosophy (B.A.) at Ruhr-Universität Bochum, 2022. You can download my full CV as a PDF.
